messages:
alex_k: alert: We're seeing missed pages from trigger-bridge starting ~11:02 UTC. Incident channel didn't get the automated alert and primary oncall wasn't paged. Customers reporting timeouts on /api/generate. Paging logs show 503 from pagerflow proxy.

mira_ops: on it — can you paste the last lines from trigger-bridge logs? I'll tail the bridge now.

alex_k: tail output:
```
2026-03-17T11:01:58Z trigger-bridge WARN suppressor: suppress window exceeded? token=abc123 status=503
2026-03-17T11:02:00Z notify-proxy ERROR webhook push failed 503
```

raj_sre: I can see PagerFlow accepted the webhook but then returned 5xx to PagerDuty. Looks like a signing/forwarding failure. Checking signer logs for TTL/rotation errors.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260317-13. PagerDuty paging attempted -> failed. :rotating_light:

elena_support: Support here — 3 customers have reported >5m latency, one timed out. This is customer-impacting; please escalate.

mira_ops: Temporary mitigation: I'm going to flip the suppressor to passthrough for 10m so pages go out. Ping infra for quick approval.

alex_k: Approved. Executed override: `curl -s -XPOST https://deploy.internal/api/suppressor/override -d '{"mode":"passthrough","reason":"incident"}'` -> 200 OK.

raj_sre: Replaying failed webhooks now: `./tools/resend_webhooks --since 2026-03-17T11:00:00Z --target=pagerflow` — queued.

elena_support: I'm sending manual Slack/SMS pages to the primary oncall for affected teams and notifying customers we're investigating.

mira_ops: Root cause looks like a cert/signing rotation that updated `/etc/trigger-bridge/signer.pem` but the process did not reload the new key. Bridge kept signing with the old key and PagerFlow rejected the signatures.

alex_k: Restarting trigger-bridge after reloading certs: `systemctl restart trigger-bridge` — restart in progress.

oncall-bot: Incident update: automation restored and manual pages sent. Paging backends reporting healthy. INC-20260317-13 -> mitigated (automated routing restored). :white_check_mark:

raj_sre: Follow-ups (action items): add a health check that compares cert fingerprint used by process vs on-disk key, alert when webhook 5xx ratio > 1% over 2m, and add a cert-rotation step that triggers a config reload of trigger-bridge.

elena_support: Drafted customer comms: acknowledged issue, described mitigation, offered credits for SLA breach if requested. Posting in #customer-notify after review.

mira_ops: Moving to post-incident: collect timeline, attach logs (trigger-bridge, pagerflow, pagerduty), and assign owners for playbook updates.

alex_k: thanks everyone — marking this thread for retro. :thumbsup:
